Deduplicate and admit campaign
One active per workspace; daily and depth limits

span.p:
Freeze baseline, sources, models and evaluator
Three cases: diagnosis + two unseen synthetic variants

div.style: color: rgb(48, 36, 81) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Separate OpenAI proposal request
Select prompt modules and retrieval order
Proposer cannot see unseen cases

div.style: color: rgb(48, 36, 81) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Six real trials
Baseline and candidate each run all three cases
Same runtime, checks and repair limits

span.p:
Activate workspace champion version
Atomic compare-and-swap guards concurrent changes

div.style: color: rgb(33, 77, 49) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Next event pins active champion
Existing events retain their original version

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reject, mark inconclusive or block
Keep current champion and evidence

div.style: color: rgb(94, 60, 9) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authorized rollback
Restore prior version; retain history

div.style: color: rgb(94, 60, 9) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Required evidence
Candidate passes 3 of 3 cases
More passes or fewer repairs
Cost and latency each within +25%
Real receipts; unchanged frozen inputs
